source_file: 猴子捞月-带背景音乐PPT（3-6 岁）.pptx

page_text_en: Hmm, how can there be such a big and round moon in the well?

page_text_en: The little monkey jumped in fright and shouted loudly: 'The moon has fallen into the well!'
summary_zh: 小猴子看到井中月亮的倒影，误以为月亮掉进了井里，吓得大喊起来。

title_en: Monkey Fetching the Moon - With Background Music PPT
source_file: 猴子捞月-带背景音乐PPT（3-6 岁）.pptx

page_text_en: The big monkey hurried over after hearing this. "Oh! There really is a big, round moon in the well!"

page_text_en: But the well is so deep, how can we fish the moon out?
